title: Chronological run from first dodge to revive and Magnet climax

clips.why: Clean first dodge and coin collection without slow tutorial intro
Leaps over the orange barrier for mid-air coins and GREAT JUMP
Escalates speed to SPD 70 with rapid lane switches and jumps
High-speed crash at 209m saved by tapping Free Revive
Post-revive surge accelerating back up to SPD 78
Peak payoff grabbing the Magnet at SPD 81 and doubling coins
Ends on the NEON LANES synthwave end card and PLAY NOW button
